remarks: This beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse offers a perfect blend of comfort and modern style. The first floor features a renovated kitchen that flows effortlessly into the dining and living areas, highlighted by gleaming hardwood floors. Sliding doors open to a private balcony, ideal for entertaining or relaxing outdoors. Upstairs, the primary suite boasts vaulted ceilings and a full bath, creating a peaceful retreat. Additional conveniences include a carport and a reserved parking space. The home also offers a spacious private storage area in the basement, providing plenty of room for your belongings. Located in Stamford, this home is close to parks, shopping, and everyday amenities. Thoughtfully designed and move-in ready, it's an exceptional opportunity for refined suburban living.
